page_title: BUR 0-1 MNU | Burnley v Manchester Utd 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Andre Onana easily deals with the threat.
90+5' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
90+3' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Jordan Beyer (Burnley) for his blatant foul.

90+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by James Trafford, who makes a glorious save!
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Manchester Utd.
90+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+1' Wow, what an escape. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Jonny Evans is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United).
88' Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
88' The percentage of ball possession is – 62:38.
86' Today's match ends for Josh Brownhill who will be replaced by Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley).
86' Manchester Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

85' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
85' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
83' Sander Berge (Burnley) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
82' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) will take the corner.

82' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Burnley.
81' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) brings his opponent down. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
80' The resulting corner from Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) is cleared by the defence.
79' The game has come to an end for Sergio Reguilon. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Raphael Varane (Manchester United).
78' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
75' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
75' The game is interrupted. Casemiro (Manchester United) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
73' The substitution is prepared. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luca Koleosho.
73' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Zeki Amdouni and he is replaced by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
73' Aaron Ramsey comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sander Berge (Burnley).
70' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
69' Casemiro (Manchester United) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
68' The corner from Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) is cleared away by the defence.
67' Josh Cullen (Burnley) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Burnley win a corner.
66' The foul by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
64' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble James Trafford.

51' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
49' Casemiro (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Tony Harrington signals a foul.

45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
45+3' Burnley keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 1 Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish!
44' The possession of the ball – 60:40.
43' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) causes Andre Onana little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
42' One of the Manchester Utd players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

33' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) takes the corner with a short pass.

33' That's unlucky! Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Burnley will take a corner kick.
30' Chance! Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
28' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) commits a foul during an attacking move.
27' The goal by Manchester Utd is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
26' Wait! Referee Tony Harrington has indicated he is going to review the Manchester Utd goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
25' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
25' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.

25' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester Utd.
22' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:2.
20' Substitution. Johann Berg Gudmundsson will be replaced by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
20' Tony Harrington blows for a foul after Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
17' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
15' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) makes a strong challenge and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
14' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' The linesman raises his flag. Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is adjudged offside.
11' Burnley work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

10' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot low towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.
9' A spell of possession for Burnley in an attempt to control the game.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but James Trafford is alert and denies him.
6' The game is interrupted as Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United) is flagged offside.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester Utd. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
